# Teachers College, Columbia University

> Teachers College is a premier graduate institution for education, psychology, and health professions, offering advanced degree programs, research opportunities, and community engagement through its faculty expertise and scholarly resources.

Teachers College is a leading graduate school affiliated with Columbia University, located in New York City. The institution serves prospective students, current scholars, faculty researchers, and alumni across education and related fields.

## Key Topics

- Graduate Programs
- Admissions & Financial Aid
- Faculty & Research
- Alumni Engagement
- Professional Development

- Student Support Services
- Education Psychology & Health
- Degree Programs

## Academics & Programs

- [Academics](https://www.tc.columbia.edu/academics): Academic programs including graduate, online, and professional studies
- [How to Apply](https://www.tc.columbia.edu/admission/how-to-apply): Step-by-step application instructions for graduate programs
- [Faculty and Research](https://www.tc.columbia.edu/faculty-and-research): Faculty directory, research centers, and expertise in education fields

## Admissions & Student Services

- [Admission & Aid](https://www.tc.columbia.edu/admission): Admissions and financial aid information for prospective students
- [Current Students](https://www.tc.columbia.edu/current-students): Resources and services hub for enrolled Teachers College students
- [Gottesman Libraries](https://library.tc.columbia.edu): Gottesman Libraries homepage with collections and research tools

## Community & Engagement

- [Alumni](https://www.tc.columbia.edu/alumni): Alumni community engagement and networking for TC graduates
- [Alumni Resources & Benefits](https://www.tc.columbia.edu/alumni/resources--benefits): Alumni benefits, tech support, and account access resources
- [Faculty and Staff](https://www.tc.columbia.edu/faculty-and-staff): Resources and directory for Teachers College faculty and staff

## Giving & Support

- [Giving](https://www.tc.columbia.edu/giving): Donation options, fundraising campaigns, and giving opportunities
- [Teachers College Scholarship Gala](https://www.tc.columbia.edu/gala): Scholarship Gala event honoring John B. King, Jr. and supporting students
